cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Every Glitch Is a Gift
cards.instruction: Turn every contradiction or failure into a surprising benefit of the impossible system.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. The office clock is dragging us backward. Excellent, we can attend the meeting we missed. Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Too far. I haven't received the invitation.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Extra preparation time. This clock understands workload.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Now it's before the booking. The boss wants my opinion: do we need this meeting?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Perfect. Tell her no. We've upgraded from attending on time to giving everyone their afternoon back.

mechanism: A leads making up a missed meeting and takes preparation work while treating increasing time reversal as progressively better workload relief.
confusable: Unlike trying to diagnose time travel, A immediately uses each excessive reversal as a practical benefit.
comparison: A meeting removed before booking differs from accessing storage through a faulty garden door.
seedUse: D164-b missed meeting, invitation and pre-booking question; S02-b provides notes or written update to preserve cooperation.
